methods.name: Multi-query Web Search
methods.description: Generates 3-5 variant search queries from the input, searches DuckDuckGo HTML for each, parses and deduplicates results by URL.

methods.name: Wikipedia API Deep Extraction
methods.description: Uses Wikipedia API to search articles, extract summaries, sections, references, and categories. Follows 'See also' links for breadth. Falls back to DuckDuckGo site-scoped search if API is unavailable.

methods.name: arXiv Academic Paper Search
methods.description: Uses arXiv API to find academic papers, extracts titles, authors, abstracts, categories, and dates. Falls back to DuckDuckGo site-scoped search if API is unavailable.

methods.name: Hybrid Multi-Source Aggregation
methods.description: Combines web search, Wikipedia, and arXiv methods into a single pipeline. Cross-references findings across sources and scores each by corroboration count.

methods.name: Iterative Deepening Search
methods.description: Does 3 rounds of progressively deeper DuckDuckGo searching. Each round analyzes results to generate focused follow-up queries. Returns results organized by depth level with theme synthesis.
